title: BTL-A4 Y-wing (Star Wars: Squadrons)

sources.title: STAR WARS: Squadrons PC text manual (EA accessibility resources)

intro: The Y-wing in Star Wars: Squadrons is the New Republic's armoured bomber for attacking big ships. It is slow but tough and has shields.

panels.name: BTL-A4 Y-wing: class and loadout
panels.text: This lists the Y-wing's class and its parts as the hangar shows them.
panels.context: All other controls work as in every Squadrons ship; the parts (components) can be changed in the hangar before a battle.

controls.name: Pilot seat
controls.text: The Y-wing has a single-seat cockpit: one pilot and no crew.
controls.context: The pilot flies alone and does every job: flying, shooting, power and team messages.

controls.name: Class: bomber
controls.text: The Y-wing is a bomber of the New Republic, made to attack capital ships (big warships).
controls.context: The class decides the ship's role in a battle and which components the hangar offers for it.

controls.name: Laser cannons
controls.text: The Y-wing's forward laser cannons fire as the primary weapon.
controls.context: They fire with the trigger; more weapon power on the hat lets them fire longer.

controls.name: Ion turret
controls.text: The Y-wing type has an ion cannon turret on top, a gun that disables ships rather than burning them.
controls.context: The catalog lists the turret for the type; in the game the ship's components are chosen in the hangar.

controls.name: Auxiliaries (left and right)
controls.text: The Y-wing carries two auxiliary components: the left one on button 3, the right one on button 4.
controls.context: Head buttons 3 and 4 on the stick use them; the auxiliary status display shows their cooldown.

controls.name: Countermeasures
controls.text: The Y-wing's countermeasure component sits on head button 6 of the stick.
controls.context: Head button 6 fires it; it is the answer to a missile warning.

controls.name: Button 7: shield focus
controls.text: On this New Republic ship base button 7 is shield focus: it points the shields to the front or the back.
controls.context: Pointing the shields at the enemy protects the side that is being hit.
